notes: AI Diagnosis window now has a provider switcher — jump between every AI you have configured (Grok/xAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama) without opening Settings. Configs are stored per provider, so setting up a second AI no longer overwrites the first. Fixed: after a restart the AI settings always showed Grok instead of the provider you configured. Grok/xAI, Anthropic, OpenAI and Ollama API keys are now tested through the local server proxy (the old direct path always failed).
